title: Registers ("x, "y)
instruction_text:
Vim has named registers - like multiple clipboards!

KEY COMMANDS:
'"x' before yank/delete = use register 'x'
'"xyy' = yank line to register x
'"xp' = paste from register x
':reg' = view all registers

Your task: Copy two words to different registers,
then paste them on the Result line.

Steps:
1. Cursor starts on 'HELLO' - press '"xyiw' to yank it to register x
2. Press 'j' to move down to 'WORLD'
3. Press '"yyiw' to yank WORLD to register y
4. Press 'j' to move to the Result line
5. Press '$' to go to the end of the line
6. Press '"xp' to paste HELLO_ from register x
7. Press '"yp' to paste WORLD from register y
8. :wq to save
